Container.Name: ChannelFlow
Container.Overview: ChannelFlow-Server — simulated live TV (channels, EPG, commercials, AI lineups, native WeatherStar, and news) with ErsatzTV next bundled in as the transcoding engine: this one container runs both ChannelFlow and next, so there is no second container to install or keep in sync. On first launch the Web UI wizard sets PostgreSQL and the admin login. Add library connections and path remaps in the UI, then paste this server's M3U and XMLTV into Jellyfin Live TV.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL server ChannelFlow can reach (entered in the first-launch wizard). The same media files Jellyfin uses, mounted at /media. Only port 8097 is used — next's HLS is proxied through ChannelFlow, so there is nothing to publish on 8409. If streams ever go dark, check the container log for [entrypoint] and ersatztv lines; there is no automatic fallback to ChannelFlow's own encoder.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: ChannelFlow Web UI, admin API, M3U/XMLTV, and the proxied next HLS streams

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Config, logos, logs, and caches. The setup wizard saves Postgres as database.json here. The bundled next engine is configured from the next/ subfolder (lineup.json, channels/), rewritten only when it really changes. Logs are logs/channelflow-YYYYMMDD.log.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Same library share Jellyfin uses. Remap Jellyfin prefixes to /media on Library → Connections.

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel VAAPI / Quick Sync — used by the bundled next encoder. Encode settings are on the Transcode tab.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA time zone for the container clock, log timestamps, and midnight jobs. Match General → schedule time zone.

Config.Name: ERSATZTV_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the ErsatzTV next binary. Leave blank to use the bundled /app/ersatztv; set it to run an external next instead.
